activities.description: Narrator explains the purpose of preservatives in preserving biological organisms.
Narrator introduces two types of preservatives: Formaldehyde solution and Formyl Acetic Acid (FAA).
Narrator provides the composition of Formaldehyde solution: 12.5 ml commercial formaldehyde and 87.5 ml water for a 100 ml solution.
Narrator provides the composition of Formyl Acetic Acid (FAA): 5 ml commercial formaldehyde, 5 ml glacial acetic acid, and 90 ml 70% ethanol for a 100 ml solution.
Narrator emphasizes FAA's effectiveness for long-term preservation.
Narrator mentions seeing preserved organisms in jars filled with FAA in labs.
